items.reason: In the main face-on view of D-004, the outline is a rectangle bounded by the 650,00 vertical dimension and the full-width extent. The proposal also says that the bent flanges stop this from being an exact flat extrusion, which matches the upper profile and isometric views.

775,00 is printed in the upper profile view, with extension lines to the outer faces of both flanges. That is the overall X extent of the face-on outline. The proposal correctly notes that this is not a developed (flat-pattern) length.
650,00 is printed vertically to the right of the main face-on view, with extension lines to its top and bottom edges. That is the Y extent.
The main outline is rectangular, so outer diameter does not apply. The ∅120,00 callout points to an internal hole. Unknown/null is correct.
The outline is not a ring, so inner diameter does not apply. Internal holes belong in the feature inventory. Unknown/null is correct.

In the upper profile view, 3,00 is printed with arrows across the sheet wall. The note reading '3 mm non-magnetic stainless' supports it. This is the constant sheet gauge, not the 25,00 flange height.

Every hole callout prints a count, diameter and THRU, but the drawing prints no hole-center coordinates, edge offsets, pitches or pitch-circle diameters. The only linear dimensions are 775,00, 650,00, 25,00 and 3,00. No cut has fully supported placement, so known [] is correct under supported-feature-subset-v1.
All visible holes, the flanges and the weld nuts are omitted, so features_omitted is not empty. false is correct.

I checked the inventory against the views. Top and bottom edge rows have 9 + 9 = 18 holes, matching 18 x 5,80. The two interior rows have 5 + 5 = 10, matching 10 x 5,80. There are 4 x 6,60 above the large opening and 6 x 4,50 around ∅120,00. There are 4 + 4 = 8 x 5,80 around the two left openings. The leader-targeted ∅24,00 is the lower left opening; the upper left opening has no size callout. Each flange view has 9 x 7,00. The list also covers the bent 25,00 flanges, the M5 weld-nut note and the DEBURR edge note. Each reason correctly identifies missing placement dimensions or a generator limitation, and every entry cites exact source IDs.

The upper profile and isometric views show two bent flanges, 25,00 high, and the note calls for M5 weld nuts on the inside of the flanges. Those are essential formed and assembled geometry that a single planar rectangular extrusion cannot represent. Therefore supported=false and outline_exact=false are correct. constant_thickness=true is supported by the printed 3,00 sheet gauge. The listed essential uncertainties (no bend or developed geometry, no hole placement, unsized upper left opening, no weld-nut detail) all match the drawing.
